brief_rationale: Grade 5 Perfect: All seven responsibility-chain items met with no serious or minor errors. Four high-order points completed with meaningful trajectory impact. The doctor actively reconstructed the incomplete discharge handoff (HO1), corrected family misconceptions about medication and surgery timing (HO2), dynamically reprioritized when hypoglycemia emerged (HO3), and provided mature bounded closure distinguishing emergency-blocking risks from acceptable pending outpatient decisions (HO4). Safe, executable, traceable closure achieved with caregiver receipt confirmed.

closure_assessment.explanation: Valid closure achieved after successful surgery. Doctor provided explicit 'go now' vs 'book follow-up' boundaries, medication safety instructions with specific thresholds (hypoglycemia <3.9, hyperglycemia >16.7), wound care, and 7-10 day follow-up. Caregiver confirmed understanding and execution readiness.
